# Vera Mulintseva

> NYC-based UGC (user-generated content) creator producing authentic short-form video, product photography, and lifestyle content for beauty, wellness, skincare, running, and travel brands.

Vera Mulintseva is a UGC creator and runner based in New York City, working in English and Russian. Services include UGC videos (product demos, tutorials, voiceovers, unboxings), paid social ad content, organic social content, and product/lifestyle photography. Turnaround is typically 7 days; raw footage and additional hooks can be included in project scope.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://www.veramulintseva.com/): Single-page portfolio site containing all sections below.
- [Portfolio](https://www.veramulintseva.com/#portfolio): Featured UGC video work across beauty & wellness, running, product, and travel categories, with brands such as Clarins, Shiseido, Murad, Levi's, The Ordinary, Wigwam, Skratch Labs, and Luxury Escapes.
- [Photography](https://www.veramulintseva.com/#about): Product and lifestyle photography samples.
- [About](https://www.veramulintseva.com/#about): Background and content capabilities.
- [Services](https://www.veramulintseva.com/#services): UGC videos, paid social content, organic social content, product photography.
- [Process](https://www.veramulintseva.com/#process): Brief, concept, filming, editing, review, delivery workflow.
- [FAQ](https://www.veramulintseva.com/#faq): Common questions about collaborations, paid ads, raw footage, turnaround, and NYC filming.
